Lines.en: Oh, goodness. Look at that horde.
It's been a while, you two. Another time travel journey, of course, what else?
...Taco? What taco? I already gave you the waffle one.
You have more, zombie, I know it!
No, I don't have any. Perhaps my enlarged zombie horde can explain it better.
Unlucky for you, Zomboss, we've come prepared.
Thank every single one of these plants. You all were amazing.
I have one more horde I haven't sent!
You will not enjoy what you'll witness tomorrow!
I don't think he was kidding about that...

BriefIntroduction.en: Shoots large peas at the enemies
Blocks zombies and produces more sun
Quickly flings stunning butter at zombies
Shoots mighty lasers down the lane
Spreads by shooting spores at zombies
Rolls bouncing, explosive shots that redirect when hitting a zombie
Eats and blocks zombies, producing sun for each zombie eaten
Blocks zombies for long, damages nearby when bitten
Sends rapid thunder at high-value targets
Flings debuffing buds at zombies, more when powered

Descriptions: Survive a supermassive zombie horde! (Lag Warning)
